en: Black‑and‑white view over a European small town nestled in a valley, photographed from an elevated dirt path lined with tall trees and a wooden railing. Two people walk along the path in the foreground. Below, dense rooftops and a prominent church with a tall spire dominate the town center, and terraced fields or vineyards cover the hills in the distance. The edges of the image show damage or wear, suggesting an old photographic postcard or glass-plate reproduction.
